readsAs: a Q shaped like a cartoon face with bangs and one eye or open mouth
a magnifying glass or search icon
a bowl or nest holding an egg
judge.why: The nest-and-egg idea doesn't come through: the flat filled cap reads as a fringe of hair over a single eye, which makes the mark look like a goofy cartoon face (childish for 13–17), and the Q tail adds an unwanted search-icon reading, even though the shapes are clean and hold up well at 16px and in one colour.
